Q: A 4-year-old child is rushed to the emergency department after developing sudden abdominal pain followed by nausea, vomiting, and dark, almost black-colored stool. Which of the following medications is the treatment for this patient's intoxication?
A) Dimercaprol
B) Deferoxamine
C) Protamine
D) Succimer
Answer:
